description_en: Call DescribeDcdnRefreshQuota to query the daily limits and remaining quotas for URL refreshes, URL prefetches, and folder refreshes
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnRefreshQuota查询当日刷新URL、预热URL及刷新目录的上限和剩余次数
name: DescribeDcdnRefreshQuota

BlockQuota.description_en: The daily quota for blocked URLs

BlockRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs that can be blocked for the day
BlockRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余封禁数量，单位：个

DirQuota.description_en: The daily quota for folder refreshes
DirQuota.description_zh: 当天刷新目录数量上限，单位：个

DirRemain.description_en: The remaining number of folders that can be refreshed for the day
DirRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余刷新目录数量，单位：个

IgnoreParamsQuota.description_en: The daily quota for refreshes that ignore URL parameters
IgnoreParamsQuota.description_zh: 当天忽略参数刷新数量上限，单位：个

IgnoreParamsRemain.description_en: The remaining number of refreshes that ignore URL parameters for the day
IgnoreParamsRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余忽略参数刷新数量，单位：个

PreloadQuota.description_en: The daily quota for URL prefetches
PreloadQuota.description_zh: 当天预热URL数量上限，单位：个

PreloadRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs that can be prefetched for the day
PreloadRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余预热URL数量，单位：个

RegexQuota.description_en: The daily quota for refreshes based on regular expressions
RegexQuota.description_zh: 当天正则刷新数量上限，单位：个

RegexRemain.description_en: The remaining number of refreshes based on regular expressions for the day
RegexRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余正则刷新数量，单位：个

UrlQuota.description_en: The daily quota for URL refreshes
UrlQuota.description_zh: 当天刷新URL数量上限，单位：个

UrlRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs that can be refreshed for the day
UrlRemain.description_zh: 当天剩余刷新URL数量，单位：个
